component.name: Gentoo Installer
component.summary: Install Gentoo to a disk, with a kernel matched to the hardware

description.p: An installer for Gentoo with a GTK4/libadwaita window and a terminal interface that share one phase pipeline. It partitions the disk (btrfs, ESP, swap), unpacks a stage3, installs a prebuilt kernel chosen for the CPU and GPU, tunes make.conf, sets up the account, the desktop and Limine, and can resume an install that failed halfway. OpenRC only.
It erases the disk you pick. Run it from a live system, not from the system it would overwrite.
